trap-superlative.notes: Rigor flag (verified, reported separately): 'Both inequalities hold for q > 1/varphi^2' is false. 1/varphi^2 = 0.381966, but Phi(q) = (q-1)(q^{3/2}+q^{1/2}-1)(q^{3/2}+q+1)/2(q+1)^2 vanishes at q = 0.465571 (the root of x^3+x-1 at x = sqrt q) and is negative on (0.465571, 1) -- e.g. Phi(0.5) = -0.0125, Phi(0.8) = -0.0474. Also the proof tests non-vanishing while the statement block requires strict positivity.
